workflow.name: Cisco Intersight - Add VLAN to VLAN policy
workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Add VLAN to VLAN policy

properties.description: Adds one fabric.Vlan to one exact fabric.EthNetworkPolicy. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organization/fabric policies and create fabric.Vlan. Before mutation it validates VLAN ID 1-4093, SharingType/conditional PrimaryVlanId, native/cluster-link restrictions, and disjoint Layer 2 constraints. It resolves organization, policy, optional multicast policy, and Primary VLAN ownership; rejects existing Name or VlanId; builds discriminator-complete relationships; and verifies POST. HTTP 2xx plus verified response proves VLAN creation. Lookup and POST lack ETag/transaction, so concurrent writers can race. An ambiguous POST may already have created the VLAN and must be inspected before retry. VLAN 1 and platform-specific disjoint/private-VLAN behavior require non-production tenant testing. Generic APIs are used until supported atomics exist.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Add VLAN to VLAN policy

properties.name: Policy Organization
properties.description: Exact organization containing the Ethernet Network Policy and optional Multicast Policy. The current organization Name schema is enforced and the value is OData-safe.

properties.name: VLAN Policy Name
properties.description: Exact fabric.EthNetworkPolicy name in Policy Organization. The current policy Name schema is enforced.

properties.name: VLAN Name
properties.description: Name for the new fabric.Vlan. It must not be blank, contain control characters, or contain URL query delimiters/encoding metacharacters &, ?, #, %, or +; apostrophes are escaped for the duplicate lookup.

properties.name: VLAN ID
properties.description: Required integer from 1 through 4093. Zero is only the unset export default and is rejected.

properties.name: Is Native
properties.description: Whether the VLAN is native. A native VLAN cannot enable Auto Allow on Cluster Links.

properties.name: Auto Allow on Uplinks
properties.description: Automatically allow the VLAN on uplinks. Set false together with Auto Allow on Cluster Links=false for disjoint Layer 2; VLAN 1 cannot be disjoint.

properties.name: Auto Allow on Cluster Links
properties.description: Automatically allow the VLAN on inter-cluster links. It cannot be true for VLAN 1 or a native VLAN.

properties.name: Sharing Type
properties.description: One of None, Primary, Isolated, or Community. Isolated and Community require an existing SharingType=Primary VLAN.

properties.name: Primary VLAN ID
properties.description: Required from 1 through 4093 only for Isolated or Community. Leave 0 for None or Primary; the referenced VLAN must already exist as Primary in the exact policy.

properties.name: Multicast Policy Name
properties.description: Optional exact fabric.MulticastPolicy name in Policy Organization. Leave blank to omit the relationship.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured JSON result for success or handled failure.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style workflow outcome code.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Short workflow outcome summary.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail; empty on success.

properties.name: Multicast Resolution JSON
properties.description: Internal initialized exact multicast-policy resolution. It remains {} when no Multicast Policy Name is supplied, avoiding references to skipped activities.

properties.name: Primary VLAN Validation JSON
properties.description: Internal initialized exact Primary VLAN proof. It remains {} unless Sharing Type is Isolated or Community.

properties.description: Performs fail-closed input and cross-field validation, rejects unsafe URL query delimiters in the free-form VLAN Name, and emits a correlated preparation token.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "VLAN input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":preparationMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
preparationToken = ""
normalizedOrganizationName = ""
normalizedPolicyName = ""
normalizedVlanName = ""
normalizedMulticastName = ""
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedPolicyName = ""
escapedVlanName = ""
escapedMulticastName = ""
normalizedVlanId = 0
normalizedPrimaryVlanId = 0
normalizedIsNative = ""
normalizedAutoAllowOnUplinks = ""
normalizedAutoAllowOnClusterLinks = ""
normalizedSharingType = ""
primaryLookupRequired = ""
multicastLookupRequired = ""

ORG_POLICY_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")

def parse_bool(value, label, errors):
    text = str(value).strip().lower()
    if text in ("true","1"):
        return True
    if text in ("false","0"):
        return False
    errors.append(label + " must be true or false.")
    return None

def parse_int(value, label, errors):
    try:
        text = str(value).strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"-?[0-9]+", text):
            raise ValueError()
        return int(text)
    except Exception:
        errors.append(label + " must be an integer.")
        return -1

try:
    organizationName = str(sys.argv[1]).strip()
    policyName = str(sys.argv[2]).strip()
    vlanName = str(sys.argv[3]).strip()
    vlanId = parse_int(sys.argv[4], "VLAN ID", [])
    errors = []
    if vlanId == -1 and str(sys.argv[4]).strip() != "-1":
        errors.append("VLAN ID must be an integer.")
    isNative = parse_bool(sys.argv[5], "Is Native", errors)
    autoAllowOnUplinks = parse_bool(sys.argv[6], "Auto Allow on Uplinks", errors)
    autoAllowOnClusterLinks = parse_bool(sys.argv[7], "Auto Allow on Cluster Links", errors)
    sharingType = str(sys.argv[8]).strip()
    primaryVlanId = parse_int(sys.argv[9], "Primary VLAN ID", errors)
    multicastName = str(sys.argv[10]).strip()

    if not ORG_POLICY_PATTERN.fullmatch(organizationName):
        errors.append("Policy Organization must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not ORG_POLICY_PATTERN.fullmatch(policyName):
        errors.append("VLAN Policy Name must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not vlanName:
        errors.append("VLAN Name must not be blank.")
    elif any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in vlanName):
        errors.append("VLAN Name must not contain control characters.")
    elif any(ch in "&?#%+" for ch in vlanName):
        errors.append("VLAN Name must not contain URL query delimiters or encoding metacharacters &, ?, #, %, or + because it is used in an exact OData lookup.")
    if multicastName and not ORG_POLICY_PATTERN.fullmatch(multicastName):
        errors.append("Multicast Policy Name must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not (1 <= vlanId <= 4093):
        errors.append("VLAN ID must be an integer from 1 through 4093.")
    if sharingType not in ("None","Primary","Isolated","Community"):
        errors.append("Sharing Type must be None, Primary, Isolated, or Community.")

    needsPrimary = sharingType in ("Isolated","Community")
    if needsPrimary:
        if not (1 <= primaryVlanId <= 4093):
            errors.append("Primary VLAN ID is required for Isolated or Community and must be from 1 through 4093.")
        elif primaryVlanId == vlanId:
            errors.append("Primary VLAN ID must differ from the new secondary VLAN ID.")
    elif primaryVlanId != 0:
        errors.append("Primary VLAN ID must be 0 (omitted) when Sharing Type is None or Primary.")

    if autoAllowOnClusterLinks is True and (vlanId == 1 or isNative is True):
        errors.append("Auto Allow on Cluster Links cannot be true for VLAN 1 or a native VLAN.")
    if autoAllowOnUplinks is False and autoAllowOnClusterLinks is not False:
        errors.append("A disjoint Layer 2 VLAN requires both auto-allow flags to be false.")
    if vlanId == 1 and autoAllowOnUplinks is False:
        errors.append("VLAN 1 cannot be configured as a disjoint Layer 2 VLAN.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation failed","details":errors}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        normalizedOrganizationName = organizationName
        normalizedPolicyName = policyName
        normalizedVlanName = vlanName
        normalizedMulticastName = multicastName
        escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'","''")
        escapedPolicyName = policyName.replace("'","''")
        escapedVlanName = vlanName.replace("'","''")
        escapedMulticastName = multicastName.replace("'","''")
        normalizedVlanId = vlanId
        normalizedPrimaryVlanId = primaryVlanId
        normalizedIsNative = "true" if isNative else "false"
        normalizedAutoAllowOnUplinks = "true" if autoAllowOnUplinks else "false"
        normalizedAutoAllowOnClusterLinks = "true" if autoAllowOnClusterLinks else "false"
        normalizedSharingType = sharingType
        primaryLookupRequired = "true" if needsPrimary else "false"
        multicastLookupRequired = "true" if multicastName else "false"
        token = {
            "Organization":organizationName,
            "PolicyName":policyName,
            "VlanName":vlanName,
            "VlanId":vlanId,
            "IsNative":isNative,
            "AutoAllowOnUplinks":autoAllowOnUplinks,
            "AutoAllowOnClusterLinks":autoAllowOnClusterLinks,
            "SharingType":sharingType,
            "PrimaryVlanId":primaryVlanId if needsPrimary else None,
            "MulticastPolicyName":multicastName or None
        }
        preparationToken = json.dumps(token, separators=(",",":"))
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "VLAN fields, sharing rules, native and cluster-link constraints, disjoint-L2 constraints, and query-safe OData literals are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated":True,"VlanId":vlanId,"SharingType":sharingType,"primaryLookupRequired":needsPrimary,"multicastLookupRequired":bool(multicastName)}, separators=(",",":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = "VLAN input preparation failed: " + str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"VLAN input preparation failed","details":preparationMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
    preparationToken = ""

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
resolutionStatus = "invalid"
organizationMoid = ""
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Organization response was invalid"
failureErrorMessage = "The organization response could not be validated."
failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
organizationSummaryJson = ""
MOID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("The response must contain a Results array.")
    results = envelope["Results"]
    if len(results) == 0:
        resolutionStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "404"
        failureStatusMessage = "Policy organization was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact Policy Organization lookup returned zero matches."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"Organization":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        resolutionStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "Policy organization lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact Policy Organization lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"Organization":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single organization result is not an object.")
        organizationMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not MOID.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
            raise ValueError("The organization Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned organization Name does not exactly match.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization":
            raise ValueError("The returned organization discriminators do not match.")
        organizationSummaryJson = json.dumps({"Moid":organizationMoid,"Name":expectedName,"ClassId":"organization.Organization","ObjectType":"organization.Organization"}, separators=(",",":"))
        resolutionStatus = "exact"
        failureStatusCode = ""
        failureStatusMessage = ""
        failureErrorMessage = ""
        failureResultJson = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    resolutionStatus = "invalid"
    organizationMoid = ""
    organizationSummaryJson = ""
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "Organization response was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The organization response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))

import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[2].strip()
resolutionStatus = "invalid"
policyMoid = ""
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "VLAN policy response was invalid"
failureErrorMessage = "The VLAN policy response could not be validated."
failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
policySummaryJson = ""
MOID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

def validate_relationship(value, expectedMoid, expectedType, label):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(label + " is not a relationship object.")
    if str(value.get("Moid","")).strip() != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError(label + " Moid does not match.")
    if str(value.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != expectedType:
        raise ValueError(label + " ObjectType does not match.")
    classId = str(value.get("ClassId","")).strip()
    if classId and classId not in ("mo.MoRef", expectedType):
        raise ValueError(label + " ClassId does not match.")

try:
    if not MOID.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
        raise ValueError("The resolved organization Moid is unusable.")
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("The response must contain a Results array.")
    results = envelope["Results"]
    if len(results) == 0:
        resolutionStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "404"
        failureStatusMessage = "VLAN policy was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact VLAN Policy Name lookup returned zero matches in the resolved organization."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"PolicyName":expectedName,"OrganizationMoid":organizationMoid}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        resolutionStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "VLAN policy lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact VLAN policy lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"PolicyName":expectedName,"OrganizationMoid":organizationMoid}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single VLAN policy result is not an object.")
        policyMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not MOID.fullmatch(policyMoid):
            raise ValueError("The VLAN policy Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned VLAN policy Name does not exactly match.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "fabric.EthNetworkPolicy" or item.get("ObjectType") != "fabric.EthNetworkPolicy":
            raise ValueError("The returned VLAN policy discriminators do not match.")
        validate_relationship(item.get("Organization"), organizationMoid, "organization.Organization", "VLAN policy Organization")
        policySummaryJson = json.dumps({"Moid":policyMoid,"Name":expectedName,"ClassId":"fabric.EthNetworkPolicy","ObjectType":"fabric.EthNetworkPolicy","OrganizationMoid":organizationMoid}, separators=(",",":"))
        resolutionStatus = "exact"
        failureStatusCode = ""
        failureStatusMessage = ""
        failureErrorMessage = ""
        failureResultJson = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    resolutionStatus = "invalid"
    policyMoid = ""
    policySummaryJson = ""
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "VLAN policy response was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The VLAN policy response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[2].strip()
resolutionStatus = "invalid"
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Multicast policy response was invalid"
failureErrorMessage = "The multicast policy response could not be validated."
failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
multicastSummaryJson = ""
MOID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

def relationship(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or str(value.get("Moid","")).strip() != organizationMoid or str(value.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "organization.Organization":
        raise ValueError("The multicast policy Organization relationship does not match.")
    classId = str(value.get("ClassId","")).strip()
    if classId and classId not in ("mo.MoRef","organization.Organization"):
        raise ValueError("The multicast policy Organization ClassId does not match.")

try:
    if not expectedName or not MOID.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
        raise ValueError("The requested multicast policy identity is incomplete.")
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("The response must contain a Results array.")
    results = envelope["Results"]
    if len(results) == 0:
        resolutionStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "404"
        failureStatusMessage = "Multicast policy was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact Multicast Policy Name lookup returned zero matches in the resolved organization."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"MulticastPolicyName":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        resolutionStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "Multicast policy lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact multicast policy lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"MulticastPolicyName":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single multicast policy result is not an object.")
        moid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not MOID.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError("The multicast policy Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned multicast policy Name does not exactly match.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "fabric.MulticastPolicy" or item.get("ObjectType") != "fabric.MulticastPolicy":
            raise ValueError("The returned multicast policy discriminators do not match.")
        relationship(item.get("Organization"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
expectedVlanId = int(sys.argv[2])
policyMoid = sys.argv[3].strip()
duplicateStatus = "invalid"
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Duplicate VLAN response was invalid"
failureErrorMessage = "The duplicate VLAN response could not be validated."
duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
MOID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

def validate_policy(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or str(value.get("Moid","")).strip() != policyMoid or str(value.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "fabric.EthNetworkPolicy":
        raise ValueError("A returned VLAN has the wrong EthNetworkPolicy relationship.")
    classId = str(value.get("ClassId","")).strip()
    if classId and classId not in ("mo.MoRef","fabric.EthNetworkPolicy"):
        raise ValueError("A returned VLAN has an invalid EthNetworkPolicy ClassId.")

try:
    if not MOID.fullmatch(policyMoid) or not (1 <= expectedVlanId <= 4093):
        raise ValueError("The expected VLAN policy or ID is invalid.")
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("The response must contain a Results array.")
    results = envelope["Results"]
    conflicts = []
    for item in results:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("A duplicate result is not an object.")
        moid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not MOID.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError("A duplicate result has an unusable Moid.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "fabric.Vlan" or item.get("ObjectType") != "fabric.Vlan":
            raise ValueError("A duplicate result has invalid discriminators.")
        validate_policy(item.get("EthNetworkPolicy"))
        rawId = item.get("VlanId")
        if not isinstance(rawId, int) or isinstance(rawId, bool):
            raise ValueError("A duplicate result VlanId is not an integer.")
        nameMatch = str(item.get("Name","")).strip() == expectedName
        idMatch = rawId == expectedVlanId
        if not (nameMatch or idMatch):
            raise ValueError("The API returned a VLAN that matches neither requested Name nor VlanId.")
        conflicts.append({"Moid":moid,"Name":str(item.get("Name","")),"VlanId":rawId,"NameMatches":nameMatch,"IdMatches":idMatch})
    if conflicts:
        duplicateStatus = "duplicate"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "VLAN name or ID already exists"
        failureErrorMessage = "At least one VLAN in the exact Ethernet Network Policy already uses the requested VLAN Name or VLAN ID."
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"conflictCount":len(conflicts),"conflicts":conflicts}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        duplicateStatus = "clear"
        failureStatusCode = ""
        failureStatusMessage = ""
        failureErrorMessage = ""
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"duplicate":False,"PolicyMoid":policyMoid,"VlanName":expectedName,"VlanId":expectedVlanId}, separators=(",",":"))
except Exception as exc:
    duplicateStatus = "invalid"
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "Duplicate VLAN response was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The duplicate VLAN response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedVlanId = int(sys.argv[1])
policyMoid = sys.argv[2].strip()
resolutionStatus = "invalid"
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Primary VLAN response was invalid"
failureErrorMessage = "The primary VLAN response could not be validated."
failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
primaryValidationJson = ""
MOID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

def validate_policy(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or str(value.get("Moid","")).strip() != policyMoid or str(value.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "fabric.EthNetworkPolicy":
        raise ValueError("The primary VLAN EthNetworkPolicy relationship does not match.")
    classId = str(value.get("ClassId","")).strip()
    if classId and classId not in ("mo.MoRef","fabric.EthNetworkPolicy"):
        raise ValueError("The primary VLAN EthNetworkPolicy ClassId does not match.")

try:
    if not MOID.fullmatch(policyMoid) or not (1 <= expectedVlanId <= 4093):
        raise ValueError("The requested primary VLAN identity is invalid.")
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("The response must contain a Results array.")
    results = envelope["Results"]
    if len(results) == 0:
        resolutionStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "422"
        failureStatusMessage = "Required primary VLAN was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "Isolated and Community VLANs require an existing Primary VLAN with the requested Primary VLAN ID in the exact policy."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"PrimaryVlanId":expectedVlanId}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        resolutionStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "Primary VLAN lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The Primary VLAN ID lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"PrimaryVlanId":expectedVlanId}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single primary VLAN result is not an object.")
        moid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not MOID.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError("The primary VLAN Moid is missing or unusable.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "fabric.Vlan" or item.get("ObjectType") != "fabric.Vlan":
            raise ValueError("The primary VLAN discriminators do not match.")
        if not isinstance(item.get("VlanId"), int) or isinstance(item.get("VlanId"), bool) or item.get("VlanId") != expectedVlanId:
            raise ValueError("The returned primary VLAN ID does not exactly match.")
        validate_policy(item.get("EthNetworkPolicy"))
        if item.get("SharingType") != "Primary":
            resolutionStatus = "not-primary"
            failureStatusCode = "422"
            failureStatusMessage = "Referenced VLAN is not a Primary VLAN"
            failureErrorMessage = "The VLAN at Primary VLAN ID " + str(expectedVlanId) + " has SharingType " + str(item.get("SharingType")) + ", not Primary."
            failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"PrimaryVlanId":expectedVlanId,"ActualSharingType":item.get("SharingType")}, separators=(",",":"))
        else:
            primaryValidationJson = json.dumps({"Moid":moid,"VlanId":expectedVlanId,"SharingType":"Primary","ClassId":"fabric.Vlan","ObjectType":"fabric.Vlan","EthNetworkPolicyMoid":policyMoid}, separators=(",",":"))
            resolutionStatus = "exact"
            failureStatusCode = ""
            failureStatusMessage = ""
            failureErrorMessage = ""
            failureResultJson = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    resolutionStatus = "invalid"
    primaryValidationJson = ""
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "Primary VLAN response was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The primary VLAN response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResultJson = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
